items.title: Can the ‘Vanguard Effect’ Extend to Wealth Management?
items.summary: CEO Salim Ramji is pushing Vanguard further into financial advice with the deal to acquire Altruist, but the hill may be steep to win over RIAs.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Rebound as Ethereum and XRP ETFs End Winning Streaks
items.summary: Ethereum funds broke a 12-day winning run and XRP snapped an 11-session streak on Wednesday, while Bitcoin ETFs bounced back with $101.15 million in one day after their worst outflow since July.

items.title: Bitcoin Reclaims $80,000 Amid Dovish Fed Signal
items.summary: BTC reached $80k again after Fed Governor Waller said he may support holding rates at the next FOMC meeting.

items.title: Lowe’s, BofA, AT&T, Nvidia, more launch workforce training initiative
items.summary: Nearly 80 companies, vendors, workforce organizations and educational institutions have joined the coalition, which aims to train 1 million people for skilled trade careers by 2035.

items.title: BlackRock Says $2.1 Trillion Gulf Spending Boom Could Reshape Global Capital Flows
items.summary: BlackRock's top strategist says Gulf sovereign wealth funds are rerouting trillions away from global markets, and the ripple effects on Treasuries, equities, and AI infrastructure could be bigger than most investors expect.
